spans.s:
bhrūṇahatyā
(‘killing the foetus’)
------------------------------------------
The topics of पुण्य (merit or virtue) and पाप (demerit or sin) have been dealt with in great detail in the पुराणस् and the धर्मशास्त्रस्. The origin of these concepts can be found even in the Ṛgveda.
Pāpas (also called pātakas) or sins have been classified as महापातकस् (heinous sins) and upapātakas (minor sins). ‘Bhrūṇahatyā’ is one of the sins included in these lists.
The word ‘bhrūṇa’ has three senses:
a learned ब्राह्मण;
a ब्राह्मण who is a Vedic student and
the foetus or the unborn baby. In all these senses, भ्रूणहत्या has been listed as a heinous sin, with practically no expiation.
